name: rare_word_anchors
description: Heavy recogniser noise: every three-word window holds an error, so no trigram survives; long words that occur once in book and transcript (Wilhelmina, lighthouse, cartographer, ...) are the only fixpoints.
segments: Wilhelmina climbed toward the lighthouse while the cartographer waited below with a lantern.
The archipelago glittered beneath a crimson evening, and the telescope trembled in her hands.
Somewhere beyond Thornfield harbour a steamship sounded its melancholy horn.
She recorded everything inside a battered notebook before descending again, whispering quietly.
